item.title: San Rafael Middle School Student of the Week
item.description: Swayzie Thornley Swayzie is the daughter of Tisha and Justin Thornley of Clawson. She participates in volleyball and basketball. Her favorite classes are math and language arts. She enjoys playing on her travel volleyball and basketball teams. She also participates in stock shows. Her future plans are to become a cosmetologist and become a photographer.
